verdict.rationale: Slate's only workspace feature is a local `/workspace` manager for reviewing and removing workspace directories within an individual CLI session. Nothing in the evidence shows creating a shared, team-wide workspace from docs and repos as a common source of truth, so this is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team

citations.quote: Use `/workspace` to open the workspace manager, where you can review and remove workspace directories.
